# TypeRB

> TypeRB is an alpha, statically typed programming language that compiles one portable source grammar to Go, Ruby, and TypeScript.

TypeRB source uses canonical, case-sensitive type names and explicit imports. Target-specific APIs require `trb/platform/<mode>/*`. Prefer the linked documentation over inferring TypeRB behavior from a target language.

## Learn

- [Learning TypeRB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/learning.md): The shortest path from installation to a small application.
- [Language guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/language.md): Practical syntax and semantics with examples.
- [A Tour of TypeRB](https://type-rb.github.io/tour/): Executable browser lessons.

## Reference

- [Language specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/specification.md): The normative language reference.
- [Standard library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/standard-library.md): Portable standard packages and APIs.
- [Command-line interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/cli.md): Commands, options, and workflows.
- [Project configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/configuration.md): `trbconfig.jsonc` and backend configuration.

## Build applications

- [Web applications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/guides/web.md): Portable routing, requests, responses, and middleware.
- [Database access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/guides/orm.md): Portable ORM models, queries, relations, and transactions.
- [Background jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/guides/jobs.md): Portable job contracts and SQL-backed workers.
- [React and JSX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/guides/react.md): Browser applications in TypeScript mode.
- [Browser HTTP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/guides/browser-http.md): Typed frontend HTTP clients.
- [Packages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/guides/packages.md): Distributed TypeRB packages and native dependencies.

## Tooling and implementation

- [AI-assisted development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/ai-assisted-development.md): A reliable tool loop for coding agents.
- [Compiler development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/development.md): Compiler architecture and contribution workflow.
- [Current status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/type-rb/type-rb/main/docs/status.md): Implemented features and known limits.
